mapper.sql: id, name, phone_enc, phone_hash, phone_masked, preferred_language AS language, status, registered_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customers (id, phone_enc, phone_hash, phone_masked, name, preferred_language, status, registered_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{phoneEnc}, #{phoneHash}, #{phoneMasked}, #{name}, #{language}, 'ACTIVE', #{now}, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO loyalty_accounts (id, customer_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE customers SET name = name#{name}, preferred_language = COALESCE(#{language}, preferred_language), updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE customers SET status = 'DELETED', phone_enc = NULL, phone_hash = NULL, phone_masked = NULL, name = NULL, deleted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
